name: tour de ridges
text:
For me, long days pedaling is a way to immerse and connect with nature and be subjected to its wonders. I saw a bobcat on Inverness Ridge, and these chance happenings draw me back out there again and again! Plus, there’s nothing like a whole day on the bike to clear the head! I needed that, and maybe need some suspension too if I do Bolinas Ridge again.

Anyway, here is my very short summary of the Marin ridges:

bolinas ridge  = extremely bumpy 😵‍💫
inverness ridge = steep but views ✨
bay ridge = always a classic 🌲

name: “Morning Gravel Ride”
text:
Dorset Divide 2026 🌞

wow, what a stunning place and amazing community of people! it was so nice being back in the UK. how to describe the cycling here? bumpy bridleways, ensnaring bramble and rogue haystacks, rolling hills overlooking thatched houses and castle ruins, coastal cliffs, purple hued heath, ancient woodlands… Dorset really has it all.
